summary: The code provides utility functions to find customers with orders and to extract unique emails from a list of customers. It suffers from nested loops and list membership tests that lead to suboptimal O(n*m) and O(n^2) time complexities.

issues.description: Nested loop over customers and orders leads to O(n*m) time complexity.
issues.suggestion: Extract order customer IDs into a set first: `order_customer_ids = {o["customer_id"] for o in orders}` and check membership in O(1).

issues.description: Membership testing on a list inside a loop results in O(n^2) time complexity.
issues.suggestion: Use a set or a dict to track seen emails: `return list(dict.fromkeys(c["email"] for c in customers))`.

suggestions: Use sets for O(1) membership lookups instead of lists when filtering or deduplicating data.
Leverage built-in comprehensions or generator expressions combined with sets to improve execution time.
